You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This specification models a buffered random-access file implementation together with an abstract RandomAccessFile refinement target and shared array/file utilities. The main module specifies the buffered object's internal fields, the effects of seek, read, write, flush, and setLength, and a collection of internal invariants about how the in-memory buffer relates to the logical and on-disk file contents. It verifies both safety-style invariants and refinement properties: the whole behavior refines an abstract RandomAccessFile spec, and each concrete operation refines its abstract counterpart. The model is single-threaded and does not use an explicit fault model; instead, underspecified file contents are represented using an ArbitrarySymbol value to keep the model checkable. The file also includes a TLC configuration section selecting constants, symmetry, aliasing, invariants, and properties for model checking.
